text: I agree with Misti Y--. Some people will love the Cirque shows and not really like Le Reve. This is a separate discussion. For me the theatre is the best part. The design and the decor is simply stunning from beginning to end. The concept behind the show is really beautiful and appealing. It doesn't translate to the actual show very well. The story isn't that entertaining. On the show that I saw, the stage kept breaking down all night. It was hard to stay engaged in it, even during the impressive scenes. Le Reve tries to reach for the flashiness and spectacle of Cirque, but never really achieves it. It's mostly for the chance to go see the beautiful theatre. Otherwise you might be better off putting your money into another show.
